hints.hint: Modern applications rely on lockfiles (such as package-lock.json or poetry.lock) to freeze dependency trees. Attackers frequently sneak in malicious code via compromised transitive dependencies.
Look at the web interface or make a GET request to find where the automated CI/CD dependency audit report is published.
Access /packages/audit/package_lock_audit.json and look through the dependencies object for any non-standard packages from untrusted authors.
Examine the apex-internal-telemetry package metadata inside the audit report. The exfiltrated_pipeline_token contains the flag in standard ZITERA{...} format.
